info.title: GTB shared API components
info.description: Reusable I01 contracts only. Feature phases add paths and enforce authorization.

BearerAuth.description: Validated OIDC access token; authorization scopes are enforced per operation in I03 and feature phases.

CorrelationID.name: X-Correlation-ID
CorrelationID.description: Use a valid supplied UUIDv4 or generate one when absent; echo on every response.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required for durable mutation commands; scope by channel and authenticated customer/actor.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor bound to authorization scope, filters and stable ordering.

CorrelationID.description: Correlation identifier echoed on all responses.

Error.description: Safe error envelope; transport errors do not establish payment business outcomes.
